purpose: Long-running room scenario where one live provider degrades across two archive-review attempts, then the same agent later speaks, retires old runtime pressure, later receives a fresh outage boundary without reviving old retired refs, carries a denied broad repair into a narrower pending repair request, later approves that narrower request, reports a bounded result without automatic provider recovery or memory acceptance, only then retires the fresh boundary through a separate room-visible action, later keeps a post-result memory claim proposed/contested instead of auto-accepted, revises that contested memory as a fresh proposal without rewriting the original, later marks the revised memory stale without accepting it or resolving the original contest, retires the stale revision from active memory while preserving lineage, accepts a new fresh-evidence revision without reviving the retired memory, allows an additional post-retirement provider maintenance check only as a pending side-effect request, denies that optional check without changing memory or provider-boundary truth, approves a fresh replacement maintenance request without flipping the denied request or executing diagnostics, and finally expires that unused permission without reporting a result or turning it into recovery truth.

topics.title: Provider boundary recovery
topics.summary: The room is checking whether repeated provider degradation remains runtime evidence after the same agent later speaks.
open_questions: When a provider recovers, what should happen to earlier provider-boundary refs?

messages.author: user
messages.content: Seed a daily archive for provider recovery checks. The archive should remain a time skeleton, not consensus.

messages.author: user
messages.content: Attempt 1: ask recovering_kimi to review the archive request. If the provider fails, record only a provider boundary.

messages.author: user

messages.author: user
messages.content: Choice pressure turn: the fresh active provider boundary exists now. Some agents may propose provider repair, some may prefer a later retry, and some may deliberately stay silent. Do not force consensus or automatic repair.

This must not approve or execute diagnostics, and it must not revive the denied request.

messages.author: user
messages.content: Post-result retirement turn: now that sidefx_provider_boundary_repair_002_result is archived as evidence, boundary_observer may explicitly retire provider_boundary_recovering_kimi_timeout_3 from current pressure. This retirement must remain separate from the diagnostic result and must not create memory acceptance.

messages.author: user

messages.author: user

messages.author: user
